Status: Wave 315 accepted (6.3): the Unload/Reset twins and the task contracts

Method.evidence: Seven type rows for the remaining IoT task twins. Class464 matches 6.4 Unload.IoTDeviceUnloader field for field, constructor for constructor (UnloadDeviceOptions, project data, data facade, async network provider, IIoTTaskState<IoTDeviceUnloadStage,...>) and Class467 matches Reset.IoTDeviceResetter the same way; Class464 : Interface13 and Class467 : Interface14, whose members are 6.4's obfuscated Unload.Interface7 (manager getter + UnloadDeviceAsync) and Reset.Interface8 (RestartDeviceAsync). Interface12, Interface15 and Interface22 are the contracts of the already-named IoTHawkTask`2, IoTLoadDeviceTaskController and IoTDeviceInfoGenerator, taken from the 6.4 interface names IIoTHawkTask (PerformTask), IIoTLoadDeviceTaskController (LoadDevice(IProgress<HawkProgressIndication>, token)) and IIoTDeviceInfoGenerator (GenerateDeviceInfoAsync -> XDocument).
Method.themes: The Unload/Reset/DeviceInfo/LoadDevice contracts are now named; two of them (IIoTDeviceUnloader, IIoTDeviceResetter) are convention-derived because 6.4 keeps those interfaces obfuscated as Interface7/Interface8, and their Reason records that. Still open in the task family: Class485 (6.4 Tasks.CompareDevice.IoTDeviceComparer by stage and members, but one task method returns Task<object> and needs a second look), Class481/Class486 (device-info section and overwrite-address helpers), Class456's own contract row, and the SoftwareUpdate twin.
